finalText:
**Big but bounded: 1082 lines across 94 files.** Four zones must keep `account_id`.

| Zone | Why |
|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | public contract, frozen |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js) | wire name, frozen |
| `migrations/*.sql`, 12 files | applied history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk`, 4 files | generated, overwritten |

125 SQL strings name the DB column. They sit in `services/*/src/repo/*.js`. That column stays until a new migration.

Safe to rename: 75 service files, plus [lib/audit.js](lib/audit.js). Ask them to rename symbols, not text.
